notes.title: Localization Update & Discord
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I was working on localization update for the past few weeks.
The Flood now also supports these languages:

Chinese
Japanese
Russian
German
Spanish
Turkish
French
Dutch
Czech

Big thanks to everyone who helped !    ːsteamhappyː

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I have also started a small discord server
Feel free to stop by if you would like to hang out and see what other projects I'm currently working on.  Join Discord Here 

Thank you for all your amazing support and have a nice day!
-Ondrej
